description: This file contains mock data helpers and functions for the SpendSense UI, including fetching dashboard summaries, transactions, insights, alerts, and settings. It is used for testing or development purposes to simulate API responses.

methods.name: fetchDashboardSummary
methods.description: Returns a mock dashboard summary with KPI data, spend series, and category breakdown.

methods.name: fetchTransactions
methods.description: Returns a list of mock recent transactions.

methods.name: fetchInsights
methods.description: Returns mock insights data for the Insights page.

methods.name: fetchSettings
methods.description: Returns mock user preferences and settings.
